newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Steniel 9-mth net loss at 127.2 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Steniel 9-mth net loss at 127.2 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine packaging firm Steniel Manufacturing Corp said on Thursday it posted a net loss of 127.2 million pesos in the first nine months of the year.

"Both of Steniel's principal operations - the corrugated carton division and the flexible packaging subsidiary - faced difficult market conditions during the period resulting in operating losses," the company said in a statement.
Steniel said it had accumulated higher than normal level of inventory when paper prices suddenly dropped in early 1996.
Overhead expenses from new plants also contributed to its burden.
Net losses are expected to persist until the end of the year, the company added.

"The consolidated results of Steniel for the first nine months are disappointing and it will take some time for the remedial measures that we have already taken to impact positively on Steniel as a whole," incoming president Augie Palisco said.
The company is consolidating its operations in the main island of Luzon in view of the extended glut in the industry.

It did not say how many workers will be laid off due to the realignment of its production line, but said the management will work for "a smooth and orderly transition towards the planned consolidation."
"It should be emphasised that these losses were caused principally by one-time, non-recurring events, and short-term start up costs relating to Steniel's investment in the future," Palisco added.
